chunks.text: ORDER SHEET IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR C.P No.0-1057 0f 2023 Date Order with signature of Judge For hearing ofmain case 15.11.2023 Petitioner is present in person Mr Niaz Hussain Maitlo, Advocate for Respondents Mr Agha Athar Hussain Pathan, AAG ## + N 11r4 ل ٤٤4 4 Learned Counsel for the Respondents has filed payment of schedule, which is taken on record and submits that payments would be paid to the petitioner in light of aforesaid schedule Petitioner, present in person agrees with this schedule and therefore, petition is accordingly disposed of. However default non payment of said amount to the petitioner would expose violator to the contempt proceedings.
